import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the Contributors page for the php52 branch using relative URL
    await page.goto("/amwhalen/archive-my-tweets/-/graphs/php52")
    # Wait for the page to load
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    # On the Contributors page, identify the top contributor (likely the first in a list)
    # Click on their name to go to their profile
    top_contributor_link = page.get_by_role("link").first  # Assuming the first link is the top contributor
    await top_contributor_link.click()
    # Wait for the profile page to load
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    # On the profile page, extract the required details
    # Use get_by_role or other selectors to find elements; adjust based on actual page structure
    full_name = await page.get_by_role("heading", level=1).inner_text()
    gitlab_account = await page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=re.compile(r"@\w+")).first.inner_text()
    location = await page.get_by_text("Location:").inner_text()
    email = await page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile(r"^[\w.%+-]+@[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$")).inner_text()
    # Print the results as-is without processing
    print(f"Full Name: {full_name}")
    print(f"GitLab Account: {gitlab_account}")
    print(f"Location: {location}")
    print(f"Email: {email}")
